title: Job
description: One labelling job as the queue serves it to a miner: a first-person video of a hands-on task, what to label, and when the work is due.

job_id.description: Opaque, unique per job. Quoted back in the submission.

url.description: Where to download the clip. V1 clips are open-source footage.

duration_s.description: Length of the clip in seconds. Every step must fall inside it.

sha256.description: Digest of the file, so a miner can check the download.

licence.description: SPDX identifier or the licence's name.

title.description: What the person in the video is doing, in a few words.

instructions.description: How to split the task into steps and what each caption must say.

max_caption_chars.description: At most 80, the protocol's own cap on a caption part; a job can only tighten it.

deadline.description: Submissions after this moment score zero.
